title: Feature development WITH prusik feels too slow (operator-felt); overhead side of overhead-to-catch ratio is unmeasured
repro: Run a normal feature sprint with the harness enabled; compare wall-clock vs the same work harness-off. No prusik surface reports where sprint time went (gate latency vs ceremony vs block-retry loops vs actual work). catches measures gate value; nothing measures gate cost. Known: ~100ms hook hot-path (interpreter startup) x thousands of tool calls/session.

resolution.verify: CUR=$(prusik --version 2>/dev/null | grep -oE '[0-9]+[.][0-9]+[.][0-9]+' | head -1); [ -n "$CUR" ] && [ "$(printf '%s\n%s\n' '0.198.0' "$CUR" | sort -V | head -1)" = '0.198.0' ] && echo "1 passed: engine carries moat-proven fix fb-e7fe8177cc8c (prusik $CUR >= 0.198.0)"
